The Progressive Era (about 1890-1920)

Reformers took on child labor, unsafe food, corrupt city machines and monopolies. Their tools: muckraking journalism, new laws, and constitutional amendments (16th-19th).

Progressives believed that the problems of industrial America from the last unit, dangerous work, unsafe products, and corporations more powerful than governments, could be solved by experts, informed citizens and an active government. They changed the Constitution four times in seven years.

As you read, keep two questions in mind. What new powers did Progressives give the government? And who gained the full rights of citizenship in this era, and who was still shut out?

Key terms: muckraker, regulation, antitrust, initiative, referendum, recall, suffrage, amendment.
title: Reformers and Their Targets
